title: Illumina RNA Prep with Enrichment: Normalization
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Create formatted CSV file
steps.instruction: Create a CSV file that includes the header line Sample_Plate,Sample_well,InitialVol,InitialConc,TargetConc and the following rows: sample_plate,A1,20,2.3,2; sample_plate,B1,20,3.99,2; sample_plate,C1,20,4.39,2; sample_plate,D1,20,3.95,2; sample_plate,E1,20,4.16,2; sample_plate,F1,20,3.81,2; sample_plate,G1,20,3.96,2; sample_plate,H1,20,3.41,2. Ensure the file is saved with a .csv extension.

steps.title: Upload CSV file
steps.instruction: In the protocol interface, upload the formatted CSV file you just created.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input any required protocol parameters in the fields provided above the CSV upload section.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol Python file (.py) from the provided source and unzip it if it is compressed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App, navigate to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and upload any needed labware definition files (.json).

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: In the OT App's Protocol tab, upload the .py protocol file you downloaded.

steps.title: Arrange deck per map
steps.instruction: Place the required labware on the robot deck according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, calibrate each piece of labware, the tip rack, and the pipette as described in the calibration support articles.

steps.title: Start protocol run
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to execute the normalization protocol.
